title: Design System: ครัววุ้นเศษส่วน ป.4

body.purpose: Short Thai cue prompts and feedback.

shadows.name: workbench-ambient
shadows.purpose: Subtle elevation on top-level panels and primary CTAs.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Snappy, friendly exponential ease-out for slicing and merging.

components.name: Combine Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA for merging slices in addition mode.
components.html: <button class="ds-cta-add" type="button">รวมชิ้นวุ้นเลย</button>
components.css: .ds-cta-add { background: var(--add, #0D7A50); color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 22px; min-height: 52px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 160ms ease; } .ds-cta-add:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3E46AD; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scoop Subtraction Button
components.description: Primary CTA for scooping slices in subtraction mode.
components.html: <button class="ds-cta-sub" type="button">ตักวุ้นออกเลย</button>
components.css: .ds-cta-sub { background: var(--sub, #C4362F); color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 22px; min-height: 52px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 160ms ease; } .ds-cta-sub:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-sub:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3E46AD; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Knife Multiplier Button
components.description: Tactile turmeric multiplier control for live tray slicing.
components.css: .ds-knife { background: var(--knife-soft, #FFF1D0); color: var(--knife-ink, #6B3E00); border: 2px solid #E5C170; border-radius: 10px; min-width: 64px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-knife:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #995B00; } .ds-knife:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3E46AD; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Segmented Navigation
components.description: 3-mode pill switcher for Guided, Sandbox, and Game modes.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab is-active">ฝึกทีละขั้น</button><button class="ds-tab">ทดลองเอง</button><button class="ds-tab">เกมร้านวุ้น</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; background: #EAF2EE; border: 1px solid #CBE0D6; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #3A534B; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab.is-active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #12231E; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(18, 35, 30, 0.06); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3E46AD; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stacked Fraction Badge
components.description: Color-coded textbook stacked fraction synced with visual trays.
components.css: .ds-frac { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; line-height: 1.12; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #252B75; padding: 2px 6px; } .ds-bar { width: 100%; min-width: 1.35em; height: 2.2px; background: currentColor; margin: 2px 0; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Sunlit Thai Jelly Kitchen Workbench
narrative.overview: A bright, tactile classroom workbench built for 9–10 year old Grade 4 learners under daylight and projector lighting. Every color, divider, and shape performs a direct mathematical job so students understand fraction equivalence, addition, and subtraction by looking and tapping rather than reading paragraphs.
keyCharacteristics: Color-coded mathematical lockstep between SVG fraction trays and stacked numerals.
Flat, open workbench surfaces separated by clean hairlines rather than nested boxes.
Touch-first 44px+ controls with gentle, non-punitive visual feedback.
Cohesive hand-painted gouache Thai storybook characters blended seamlessly onto light porcelain surfaces.

rules.name: The Mathematical Color Rule
rules.body: Never use Butterfly-Pea, Pandan, Hibiscus, or Turmeric as arbitrary decoration; each hue maps strictly to starting fraction, addition, subtraction, and slicing respectively.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every stacked fraction, knife multiplier, and readout uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so live updates never shift layout horizontally.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Inner sections inside a workbench panel never receive secondary bordered card shells; they use open whitespace and hairline dividers.

dos: Do keep all interactive buttons at least 44x44px (46px-52px on pointer: coarse).
Do pair subtraction cutouts with diagonal hatching so colorblind learners distinguish removed slices without relying on color alone.
Do keep instructional copy concise (2-5 Thai words) and let real-time SVG changes demonstrate every rule.
Do blend gouache character illustrations with mix-blend-mode: multiply on white/tinted light surfaces without artificial circular crop masks.
donts: Don't substitute Unicode emojis for UI icons; use the uniform 2px-stroke SVG icon set.
Don't nest bordered cards inside workbench panels or add decorative one-sided left border strips.
Don't introduce countdown timers, harsh error buzzers, or negative subtraction problems in Grade 4 modes.
